title: Wolfenstein 3D
notes: Vault reads your save games (SAVEGAM0-9) and never touches the game. Progress counts when you save, so save on each new floor.
Includes Spear of Destiny, which comes with the Steam version.
Save layout from id Software's released Wolfenstein 3D source code.

testGuide.title: Start and save
testGuide.detail: Start Episode 1 and save on floor 1. The episode achievement should pop up and "Last save" should show episode 1, floor 1.
